summary.summary: On 2026-01-24 at 10:43 UTC, auth-service generated a HIGH‑severity credential‑stuffing alert. In a one‑hour window, 34 distinct usernames failed login attempts from 33 different sources, far above the learned baseline (z‑score 33). This represents a sharp spike compared with normal login failure rates.
summary.likely_trigger: A credential‑stuffing attack targeting auth-service (ATT&CK T1110.004) triggered the alert.
summary.suggested_next_check: Review the raw authentication logs for the affected hour to identify the source IPs and usernames involved and verify rate‑limit or block rules are applied.
